tips.text: Run the top-tier Antivirus bounty every day; on Steel Path, three runs in about 20 minutes cap you.
Grab the glowing Hex Treasures in every Höllvania mission; several players capped on treasures alone.
Use Parallax's air support to ping Hex Treasures on the map.
Keep one of each small treasure instead of trading them all in; Rank 3 and Rank 5 each eat a full set.
Lean on gifts and each bounty's assigned member for chemistry if you skip the KIM chats; it is slower but works.
Buy the EFV-5 Jupiter from Minerva on the same visit.
Players almost unanimously call the Hex the easiest syndicate to max.
Treat it as a one-time mastery farm; it looks great but is one of the weakest secondaries.
